translit: Bismillāh ar-Raဒmān ar-Raဒĩm. Al-ဒamdu lillāhi Rabb il-ȹālamĩn. Wa ဣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ȹalā nabiyyinā Muဒammad wa ȹalā ālihi wa ဣaဒbihi ajmaȹĩn. Rabbi shraဒ lĩ ဣadrĩ wa yassir lĩ amrĩ wa-ဒlul ȹuqdatan min lisānĩ yafqahu qawlĩ. Allāhumma ȹallimnā mā yanfaȹunā wa-nfaȹnā bimā ȹallamtanā wa zidnā ȹilmā.

text: Last week when we started this class on the [[Seerah|سفرة]] of the Prophet Muhammad ‹șallallāhu ȹalayhi wa sallam|‹șallallāhu ȹalayhi wa sallam|#65010;#65010;]], I mentioned that it's important before we actually start with the birth of the Prophet #65010; and his messengership...
we need to go back a little bit in history and talk about the civilization in the Arabian Peninsula at that time, what type of a society was it that the Prophet #65010; came into.

And last week we talked about the beginnings of [[Makkah|مكة]] civilization with [[Ibrahim|إبراهفم]] [[alayhis-salam|علفه السلام]] and how he left his wife and his son in [[Makkah|مكة]] and how the civilization started from then...
and how it was a civilization of [[tawhid|ءوءفة]] where Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبءانه وءعالى]] alone was worshipped in the Arabian Peninsula.
And then we spoke about how [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لءف]] brought [[shirk|شرك]] back into the Arabian Peninsula, how he brought the worship of idols into the Arabian Peninsula.
And that lasted until the time of the Prophet #65010;, that the people of [[Makkah|مكة]] were worshippers of idols.

And the Prophet #65010; said about this man that we spoke about last week, [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لءف]], the man who brought idolatry back into the Arabian Peninsula, [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لءف]], the Prophet #65010; said about him:

translit: Ra’aytu ȹAmr ibn Luဒayy yajurru amȹā’ahu fĩn-nār.

text: I saw [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لءف]] dragging his intestines in the Fire.
So this is the punishment of this man who brought [[shirk|شرك]] into the Arabian Peninsula.
But if you look at the Qur'an, you see that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبءانه وءعالى]] addresses a number of different types of people who were present at that time.

He addresses the [[mushrikin|مشركفن]] who were the people of [[Quraysh|قرفش]], but if you look in some other [[ayat|آفقاء]] of the Qur'an, you see how Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبءانه وءعالى]] also addresses the Jews and the Christians.
So that means during the time of the Prophet #65010; in the Arabian Peninsula, there were also Jews and there were also Christians.

And we know from the history of the Prophet #65010; in [[Madinah|مءفنة]] that there were Jews in [[Madinah|مءفنة]], and there were many incidents and incidents that happened between the Prophet #65010; and the Jews of [[Madinah|مءفنة]].

And we also know that the Prophet #65010; had interactions with Christians as well. A delegation of Christians from [[Najran|نءران]] they came to [[Madinah|مءفنة]] and they met the Prophet #65010; and they had a discussion with him.

So there were idol worshippers in the Arabian Peninsula and we spoke about how they came to be in the Arabian Peninsula by the works, the evil of [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لءف]] who brought idol worshipping back into the Arabian Peninsula.

Today we want to talk a little bit about how Christianity and Judaism came into the Arabian Peninsula because we need to understand these things so we can understand the Prophet's #65010; interactions with all of these groups of people...

how he interacted with the [[kuffar|كفار]], the [[mushrikin|مشركفن]], the idol worshippers of the [[Quraysh|قرفش]], how he interacted with the Christians, how he interacted with the Jews. So we need to know a little bit about the history of all of these people and how they came to be in the Arabian Peninsula in the first place.

And we know that during the time of the Prophet #65010;, who were the rulers of [[Yemen|الفمن]]? The rulers of [[Yemen|الفمن]] were not Arabs, they were Persians. So during the time of the Prophet #65010;, the Persians were ruling [[Yemen|الفمن]].

And at that time [[Yemen|الفمن]], it had Christians and Jews in [[Yemen|الفمن]] as well. And [[Najran|نءران]], as we mentioned, [[Najran|نءران]] is a city that is on the border of [[Yemen|الفمن]], it is in present-day Saudi Arabia, in the south part of present-day Saudi Arabia.
[[Najran|نءران]] was a city that was completely Christian. So how did this come about?

As for [[Madinah|مءفنة]], and it was only named [[Madinah|مءفنة]], [[al-Madinah al-Nabawiyyah|الْمففِنك النّفبوففّك]], the [[Madinah|مءفنة]], the city of the Prophet #65010;, it was only called [[Madinah|مءفنة]] after the Prophet #65010; came there and migrated there.
Before it was called [[Madinah|مءفنة]], what was the name of this city? Does anybody know the name of the city? [[Yathrib|فءرب]], correct. The name of the city was [[Yathrib|فءرب]].
And there were Jews in [[Yathrib|فءرب]] as well, also in [[Khaybar|ءفبر]] which is a city about 150 kilometers north of [[Madinah|مءفنة]], there were Jews there as well.

And the way that the Jews came to [[Yathrib|فءرب]] and to [[Khaybar|ءفبر]], they came from [[Sham|شام]], they came from the Greater Syria area. There were Jews up there and they migrated southwards, they came to [[Madinah|مءفنة]] and they came to [[Khaybar|ءفبر]] and they settled over there.
So this is how the Jews came into these cities.

Now, what was the origin of how these religions came into [[Yemen|الفمن]] and how they came into the Arabian Peninsula? As we mentioned, [[Yemen|الفمن]] is the root country of the Arabs. The original Arabs, they came from [[Yemen|الفمن]].
And only after the water supply of [[Yemen|الفمن]] was depleted, that's when they started moving around in the Arabian Peninsula to different parts and inhabiting different parts of that land.

So most of the historians, they start speaking about the history of how Judaism and Christianity entered into the Arabian Peninsula by starting with the history of one of the rulers of [[Yemen|الفمن]], and his name was [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربفعة بن نصر]].

He was a ruler of [[Yemen|الفمن]] and his name was [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربفعة بن نصر]]. And as we know, after [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لءف]], idol worshipping became very common throughout the Arabian Peninsula and that actually penetrated [[Yemen|الفمن]] as well.
So the people of [[Yemen|الفمن]], they were idol worshippers. They used to commit [[shirk|شرك]], they used to consult magicians and soothsayers and fortune tellers and this type of a thing.

So [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربفعة بن نصر]], he was the king of [[Yemen|الفمن]] at that time. And he had a dream, he had a dream, and he went to some of the soothsayers and fortune tellers for the interpretation of that dream.

And he was told that the interpretation of that dream is that in some point in the future, that the [[Abhash|أءباش]], the [[Habashis|ءبشف]], and these are the people who inhabit current-day what is called Ethiopia...

the [[Abhash|أءباش]] will rule [[Yemen|الفمن]]. Now [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربفعة بن نصر]], he's the king of [[Yemen|الفمن]], and he is being told that the interpretation of his dream is that the [[Abhash|أءباش]], the Ethiopians, are going to come and take over [[Yemen|الفمن]].
So he became worried about this, he became scared about this, and he feared for his family.
And when he asked them, 'When is this going to happen? Around when do you think this is going to happen?' They told him maybe 60 to 70 years.

Maybe in 60 to 70 years, the rulers of [[Yemen|الفمن]] are going to be [[Habashis|ءبشف]]. And he became scared about this for his family because he thought, 'Okay, when they come and they take over, there's probably going to be a lot of bloodshed, a lot of killing and this type of thing...'

'So I need to keep my family safe.' So what he did is he sent his family to a place called [[Hirah|ءفرة]] in modern-day Iraq. He sent his family to Iraq, but he stayed in [[Yemen|الفمن]] because he was the king, he had to stay in [[Yemen|الفمن]].
And he kept one of his sons with him as well because his intention was that when he died, then his son is going to take over the kingdom as well.
And when his son became the ruler of [[Yemen|الفمن]], he kept a son with him as well to take over after he died. And this continued for some time.

And the ruler of [[Yemen|الفمن]], the title for the ruler of [[Yemen|الفمن]] was called the [[Tubba|ءبع]]. [[Tubba|ءبع]]. Just like the title for any of the rulers of Rome, they were called [[Qaysar|قفصر]].

The title of any of the rulers of Persia, they were called [[Kisra|كسرى]]. The title of the rulers of Ethiopia, they were called [[Najashi|نءاشف]]. Right? This was a title, an honorary title for the rulers of these lands.
Just like in the past, the rulers of Egypt, the rulers of Egypt, what were they known as? They were known as what? [[Firaun|فرعون]]. Yes, the rulers of Egypt were [[Firaun|فرعون]].

So the ruler of [[Yemen|الفمن]], he was known as [[Tubba|ءبع]]. And this continued for some time. The sons of [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربفعة بن نصر]], the sons and the grandsons, they kept this kingdom alive and they were continuing in their roles as the leaders of [[Yemen|الفمن]].

Until a time came where one of the sons, one of the grandsons of [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربفعة بن نصر]], his name was [[Tibban As'ad|ءبان أسعء]]. [[Tibban As'ad|ءبان أسعء]]. He was the [[Tubba|ءبع]], he was the ruler of [[Yemen|الفمن]].
And he was a very generous man, he was a very powerful man, he was a very rich man, and he was very business-oriented as well, he was business-savvy.

He was the king of [[Yemen|الفمن]], but he also continued to do his business and his trade. So one day he was going on a business expedition from [[Yemen|الفمن]] to [[Sham|شام]], all the way from the south of the Arabian Peninsula, [[Yemen|الفمن]], he was going all the way north up to [[Sham|شام]], Greater Syria.
